title: KaavaErrorCode
description: Standard JSON-RPC error codes plus the Kaava range.
signature: const KaavaErrorCode: { ParseError, InvalidRequest, MethodNotFound, InvalidParams, InternalError, ProcessExited, Timeout, HandshakeFailed }
semantics: Error codes match JSON-RPC 2.0 spec for -32700 to -32603; Kaava codes are -32000 to -32002.
